statement: Offline temporal measurements validate complete E1c version-1 plan order and every diagnostic payload size/hash through the same D1/D2 descriptors used for decoding. Linear-light evidence uses reader-only schema 4 while schemas 1-3 retain their channel grammars. Stable producer keys survive capture-local ID and pixel reordering; unknown or ambiguous identity, missing evidence and empty masks report ineligible coverage. Adjacent RGB/luminance/depth/material/ownership changes and classified motion, steady-hold flicker with thirty usable samples and sixty-four pixels covering one percent of the ROI, attributed pops, tick-normalized dusk/dawn light and exposure derivatives against recorded solar progression, and versioned world-seam persistence emit deterministic JSON with advisory, qualified or ineligible result states. Histograms and frame/producer/window budgets bound work and storage; at most eight events per metric and forty per sequence are retained. Registered stdlib-only positive/defective, eligibility, refusal, identity and determinism regressions run through the existing Python registry and CTest. Per-ROI versioned thresholds enforce only with structurally valid identical-input repeated runs, known-good and deliberately defective fixture verdicts and owner review matching the backend, cadence and span. Qualified threshold misses and unavailable expected samples fail; absent qualification evidence remains advisory. Shipped baselines are unchanged and advisory. The existing montage builder emits bounded labelled before/current/after, delta and mask SVG slots with explicit unavailable evidence and draw/asset probes. Registered synthetic qualification and montage regressions cover one-frame defects, repeat determinism, evidence refusal, tie order and caps. Native evidence producers and production qualification remain pending; no production threshold or all-features result is claimed.

evidence.planned: Integrate native temporal evidence producers and separately review production qualification before enforcement; owner: maintainers
